text: Is this a cannon attack?!\nWhere's the ark? What happened to Kunon and the\nothers?!
Oh, you guys showed up just in time!!
Ugh! Go stop this bombardment!\nIt's coming from the uplands on the left.
Come to think of it, this is the nature of\nbandits. When they see such a rare thing, they'll\nwant to shoot it down.
What?! There are bandits in Toram?!
Of course. Some of them are weredragons, and\nlately many stray dragons have become bandits too.\nI bet there are a few Eumano bandits too.
My gosh!! Okay, enough talking!!\nWe need to stop those bandits quickly, or they'll\nblow us up first!!
